title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Discounts and the Price a Member Pays
content:
Holding a Wanderlane Traveller Club tier changes what the member pays elsewhere in the portfolio: the tier's hotel, car rental, package and insurance discounts apply to the rates of those products, and the product's own rules decide everything else.

**The basis the discount acts on.** A club discount is applied to the room, vehicle, package or premium price before taxes and third-party fees, never after. The basis is the price before taxes and third-party fees, so the discount percentage of the tier is taken on that price and not on the total the member is finally billed.

**Where a corporate programme reference is on the booking.** A club discount and a corporate programme rate are mutually exclusive: where a booking carries a corporate programme reference the corporate rate stands alone and the club discount is not applied on top.

**What the member then earns.** Points accrue on the discounted price actually paid and not on the price before the discount.

**A tier that moves between booking and travel.** Where the member's tier changes between booking and travel, the discount that was applied at booking stands and is neither topped up nor clawed back.

**A booking paid entirely with points.** No club discount is applied to a booking paid for entirely with points, because the price paid in money is nothing.

## The order the price is built in

| Step of the price | What is read |
| --- | --- |
| The room, vehicle, package or premium price before taxes and third-party fees | The basis the club discount acts on |
| The tier's discount percentage for that product | Taken on that basis, never on the price after taxes and third-party fees |
| Taxes and third-party fees | Added to the discounted price; the discount never reaches them |
| The points the booking earns | Measured on the discounted price actually paid |

## Points of judgement

*A booking carries a corporate programme reference and the traveller also holds a club tier.* The corporate rate stands alone and the club discount is not applied on top: the two are mutually exclusive.

*A member holding one tier at booking is promoted before travel and asks for the better discount.* The discount that was applied at booking stands. It is neither topped up for the higher tier nor clawed back had the tier fallen instead.

*A member asks why an award booking settled wholly in points carries no club discount.* The price paid in money is nothing, so no club discount is applied to it.

*A member asks whether their points will be measured on the price before their discount.* They will not. Points accrue on the discounted price actually paid.
